owner_question: Can the owner see collection/purpose/vendor/access/request evidence before giving tool access?
first_safe_evidence: Public URLs; form fields; tool list; redacted workflow screenshots; draft notice and opt-out copy
good_fit_when: Useful before CRM WhatsApp chatbot agency or privacy review spend when the buyer needs an evidence register without customer exports
red_flags_or_stop_rules: Stop if passwords OTPs unredacted customer data payment records health data or legal claims are requested
claim_boundary: Operational readiness only; not legal advice DPDP compliance proof savings ROI ranking lead or revenue claim

owner_question: What legal basis notice consent contract and request-response wording need counsel review?
first_safe_evidence: Current policy drafts; consent copy; processing purpose list; vendor list; unresolved legal questions
good_fit_when: Useful when legal interpretation contracts notices or statutory obligations need qualified counsel
red_flags_or_stop_rules: Stop if operational tooling is changed without owner implementation evidence or counsel scope
claim_boundary: May provide legal advice only if appropriately qualified and engaged; AICS does not claim legal opinion

owner_question: Which fields workflows templates and opt-outs will the tool enforce?
first_safe_evidence: Field map; consent source; template purpose; access roles; export and deletion workflow
good_fit_when: Useful after owner has purpose and access evidence and wants implementation
red_flags_or_stop_rules: Stop if vendor asks for full customer export admin access or promotional automation before consent/request route is clear
claim_boundary: Tool capability is not DPDP compliance proof appointment proof or revenue proof

route: Chatbot AI receptionist or lead automation agency
owner_question: Which messages can be automated safely and what must be human-reviewed?
first_safe_evidence: Approved intents; escalation rules; blocked sensitive data examples; opt-out wording; handoff owner
good_fit_when: Useful when enquiry routing is repetitive and evidence boundaries are documented
red_flags_or_stop_rules: Stop if bot handles sensitive records complaints legal requests or unapproved claims without human review
claim_boundary: Automation performance accuracy compliance and revenue outcomes are unverified unless separately measured

owner_question: Can campaigns collect leads without creating consent evidence gaps?
first_safe_evidence: Landing page fields; ad promise; form notice; UTM/source register; retention owner
good_fit_when: Useful before scaling ads forms or WhatsApp click-to-chat campaigns
red_flags_or_stop_rules: Stop if campaign promises compliance results discounts or follow-up without owner-approved data handling
claim_boundary: Marketing traffic leads rankings and conversion claims are not verified here

owner_question: Can the owner maintain a basic consent and request register before buying software?
first_safe_evidence: Spreadsheet columns; owner names; request log; monthly access review; deletion/correction tracker
good_fit_when: Useful for early-stage SMBs needing a low-cost evidence baseline
red_flags_or_stop_rules: Stop if files contain unredacted sensitive data broad access no retention owner or no backup
claim_boundary: Manual process is a temporary control not certification audit opinion or compliance guarantee
